name: iaris-web
description: IARIS Cyber & Data – website (React + Vite frontend, Express + Prisma backend) deployable on Vercel

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.dev:admin: concurrently -n api,admin -c cyan,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck -w admin
scripts.local:setup: npm run local:db && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev -w admin"
